13trait ManagesTransactions

15    /**
16     * @template TReturn of mixed
17     *
18     * Execute a Closure within a transaction.
19     *
20     * @param  (\Closure(static): TReturn)  $callback
21     * @param  int  $attempts
22     * @return TReturn
23     *
24     * @throws \Throwable
25     */
26    public function transaction(Closure $callback, $attempts = 1)
27    {
28        for ($currentAttempt = 1; $currentAttempt <= $attempts; $currentAttempt++) {
29            $this->beginTransaction();
30
31            // We'll simply execute the given callback within a try / catch block and if we
32            // catch any exception we can rollback this transaction so that none of this
33            // gets actually persisted to a database or stored in a permanent fashion.
34            try {
35                $callbackResult = $callback($this);
36            }
37
38            // If we catch an exception we'll rollback this transaction and try again if we
39            // are not out of attempts. If we are out of attempts we will just throw the
40            // exception back out, and let the developer handle an uncaught exception.
41            catch (Throwable $e) {
42                $this->handleTransactionException(
43                    $e, $currentAttempt, $attempts
44                );
45
46                continue;
47            }
48
49            $levelBeingCommitted = $this->transactions;
50
51            try {
52                if ($this->transactions == 1) {
53                    $this->fireConnectionEvent('committing');
54                    $this->getPdo()->commit();
55                }
56
57                $this->transactions = max(0, $this->transactions - 1);
58            } catch (Throwable $e) {
59                $this->handleCommitTransactionException(
60                    $e, $currentAttempt, $attempts
61                );
62
63                continue;
64            }
65
66            $this->transactionsManager?->commit(
67                $this->getName(),
68                $levelBeingCommitted,
69                $this->transactions
70            );
71
72            $this->fireConnectionEvent('committed');
73
74            return $callbackResult;
75        }
76    }

78    /**
79     * Handle an exception encountered when running a transacted statement.
80     *
81     * @param  \Throwable  $e
82     * @param  int  $currentAttempt
83     * @param  int  $maxAttempts
84     * @return void
85     *
86     * @throws \Throwable
87     */
88    protected function handleTransactionException(Throwable $e, $currentAttempt, $maxAttempts)
89    {
90        // On a deadlock, MySQL rolls back the entire transaction so we can't just
91        // retry the query. We have to throw this exception all the way out and
92        // let the developer handle it in another way. We will decrement too.
93        if ($this->causedByConcurrencyError($e) &&
94            $this->transactions > 1) {
95            $this->transactions--;
96
97            $this->transactionsManager?->rollback(
98                $this->getName(), $this->transactions
99            );
100
101            throw new DeadlockException($e->getMessage(), is_int($e->getCode()) ? $e->getCode() : 0, $e);
102        }
103
104        // If there was an exception we will rollback this transaction and then we
105        // can check if we have exceeded the maximum attempt count for this and
106        // if we haven't we will return and try this query again in our loop.
107        $this->rollBack();
108
109        if ($this->causedByConcurrencyError($e) &&
110            $currentAttempt < $maxAttempts) {
111            return;
112        }
113
114        throw $e;
115    }

121     *
122     * @throws \Throwable
123     */

125    {

128        }

131

139    }

143     *
144     * @return void
145     *
146     * @throws \Throwable
147     */

151            $this->reconnectIfMissingConnection();
152
153            try {
154                $this->executeBeginTransactionStatement();
155            } catch (Throwable $e) {

157            }
158        } elseif ($this->transactions >= 1 && $this->queryGrammar->supportsSavepoints()) {

160        }
161    }

182     *
183     * @throws \Throwable
184     */

186    {

196    /**
197     * Commit the active database transaction.
198     *
199     * @return void
200     *
201     * @throws \Throwable
202     */
203    public function commit()
204    {
205        if ($this->transactionLevel() == 1) {
206            $this->fireConnectionEvent('committing');
207            $this->getPdo()->commit();
208        }
209
210        [$levelBeingCommitted, $this->transactions] = [
211            $this->transactions,
212            max(0, $this->transactions - 1),
213        ];
214
215        $this->transactionsManager?->commit(
216            $this->getName(), $levelBeingCommitted, $this->transactions
217        );
218
219        $this->fireConnectionEvent('committed');
220    }

222    /**
223     * Handle an exception encountered when committing a transaction.
224     *
225     * @param  \Throwable  $e
226     * @param  int  $currentAttempt
227     * @param  int  $maxAttempts
228     * @return void
229     *
230     * @throws \Throwable
231     */
232    protected function handleCommitTransactionException(Throwable $e, $currentAttempt, $maxAttempts)
233    {
234        $this->transactions = max(0, $this->transactions - 1);
235
236        if ($this->causedByConcurrencyError($e) && $currentAttempt < $maxAttempts) {
237            return;
238        }
239
240        if ($this->causedByLostConnection($e)) {
241            $this->transactions = 0;
242        }
243
244        throw $e;
245    }

247    /**
248     * Rollback the active database transaction.
249     *
250     * @param  int|null  $toLevel
251     * @return void
252     *
253     * @throws \Throwable
254     */
255    public function rollBack($toLevel = null)
256    {
257        // We allow developers to rollback to a certain transaction level. We will verify
258        // that this given transaction level is valid before attempting to rollback to
259        // that level. If it's not we will just return out and not attempt anything.
260        $toLevel = is_null($toLevel)
261            ? $this->transactions - 1
262            : $toLevel;
263
264        if ($toLevel < 0 || $toLevel >= $this->transactions) {
265            return;
266        }
267
268        // Next, we will actually perform this rollback within this database and fire the
269        // rollback event. We will also set the current transaction level to the given
270        // level that was passed into this method so it will be right from here out.
271        try {
272            $this->performRollBack($toLevel);
273        } catch (Throwable $e) {
274            $this->handleRollBackException($e);
275        }
276
277        $this->transactions = $toLevel;
278
279        $this->transactionsManager?->rollback(
280            $this->getName(), $this->transactions
281        );
282
283        $this->fireConnectionEvent('rollingBack');
284    }
285
286    /**
287     * Perform a rollback within the database.
288     *
289     * @param  int  $toLevel
290     * @return void
291     *
292     * @throws \Throwable
293     */
294    protected function performRollBack($toLevel)
295    {
296        if ($toLevel == 0) {
297            $pdo = $this->getPdo();
298
299            if ($pdo->inTransaction()) {
300                $pdo->rollBack();
301            }
302        } elseif ($this->queryGrammar->supportsSavepoints()) {
303            $this->getPdo()->exec(
304                $this->queryGrammar->compileSavepointRollBack('trans'.($toLevel + 1))
305            );
306        }
307    }

309    /**
310     * Handle an exception from a rollback.
311     *
312     * @param  \Throwable  $e
313     * @return void
314     *
315     * @throws \Throwable
316     */
317    protected function handleRollBackException(Throwable $e)
318    {
319        if ($this->causedByLostConnection($e)) {
320            $this->transactions = 0;
321
322            $this->transactionsManager?->rollback(
323                $this->getName(), $this->transactions
324            );
325        }
326
327        throw $e;
328    }
